Replace this text in content/channels.json with your exhibition copy. Paragraphs are separated by blank lines in the source string, or use a single block of text with automatic wrapping.

This simulator runs at 800×480 — the same resolution as common 7″ ESP32-S3 display boards.

Second delegate station. Only one channel can be live at a time, like a single microphone in the Security Council chamber.

Use the control panel or keys 1–4 to open a channel. Press Escape or Close to return to idle.
Third station content. The show controller broadcasts state over WebSocket so every screen — and later every ESP32 — stays in sync.
Fourth station. Physical buttons will eventually send the same events as the control panel: channel open and channel close.
